description:
*“Even after losing her memories, it’s still Jin Kyudo… What a cruel connection…”*

Jin Kyudo, in his attempt to start a new life, reunites with his long-lost lover Shin Danbi at the company where he has just been hired. While Kyudo is completely flustered, Danbi remains eerily calm. The truth is, an accident erased every bit of their past together from her memory. Not wanting to hurt her twice, Kyudo tries to distance himself. But Danbi keeps getting drawn to the warmth and strange familiarity she feels from this strange man. This way, a tangled romance unfolds. Kyudo struggles in his attempt to let go, Danbi refuses to, and Ahn Choi weaves herself between them like a thread in a messy knot. Into the empty space left by lost memories, new emotions slowly soak in.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
